info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v1-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Partners API provides a comprehensive list of partners participating in the hotel loyalty points program. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve detailed information about various partners, facilitating easier integration for loyalty program management. Typical use cases include querying partner details for promotional activities and enhancing customer engagement strategies. Developers can leverage this API to support applications that offer rewards and benefits aligned with hotel loyalty initiatives.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of partners associated with points.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about partners linked to the points system. It returns a comprehensive list of partners, which can be used for various applications such as rewards programs or partnership management.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of partners.
